title: GlossMark repository config
description: The repo-level glossmark.yaml: the ontology namespaces this repository owns and imports, prefix aliases, the views file, scanning options and the gate policy. Mirrors model.Config in internal/model/files.go, which decodes with KnownFields(true), so unknown keys are errors.

owns.description: Namespaces this repository owns, keyed by CURIE prefix. Each owned namespace has an ontology file (default ontology/<prefix>.gloss.yaml).

imports.description: Namespaces imported from elsewhere, keyed by CURIE prefix.

prefixes.description: Extra CURIE prefix → IRI base mappings (for example boundary namespaces) that are neither owned nor imported ontologies.

repo-iri.description: The repository's own IRI. A boundary prefix not declared under prefixes: expands to <repo-iri>boundaries/<prefix>/.

source-url.description: Template linking viewer paths to a code host, with {path} and {line}: https://github.com/o/r/blob/main/{path}#L{line}.

views.description: Path (relative to this file) of the views.yaml projections file. Default: ontology/views.yaml.

exclude.description: Globs of paths the scanner skips.

comment-styles.description: Extends the builtin comment-token table. Keys are a lower-case file extension including the dot (".foo") or an exact file basename ("Dockerfile"); values are the comment tokens that may open an @gloss marker in such files.

test-paths.description: Globs whose markers default to the verifies relation when relation inference runs. Default: common test layouts.

grammar.description: The @gloss grammar version the repository is written in (default 1). The tool refuses a grammar it does not support.

iri.description: An IRI base; CURIEs expand by concatenating the local name to it, so it normally ends in / or #.

glob.description: A slash-separated path glob; ** matches across directories.

tier.description: Ontology tier: core (the business ideal) or implementation (the concrete system).

file.description: The *.gloss.yaml ontology file, relative to the repo root. Default: ontology/<prefix>.gloss.yaml.

owner.description: Team or actor that owns the namespace.

source.description: Where to fetch the ontology: a local path (directory or file), a git+ URL (git+https://..., git+ssh://...) or an https URL.

policy.description: The configurable gate policy (model.Policy). Omitted fields take the defaults from the design: soft-conf-threshold 0.7, hard-paths [ontology/**, **/.gloss.yaml, glossmark.yaml].

soft-conf-threshold.description: Proposed links at or above this confidence are SOFT; below it they are HARD.

hard-paths.description: Globs whose changes are always HARD.

auto-accept-soft.description: When true, gloss accept --policy accepts SOFT proposals.

coverage-fail-under.description: Default for gloss coverage --fail-under, in percent.

criticality-gates.description: Minimum gate for a change that touches a concept or boundary at or above a criticality level (docs/GOVERNANCE.md). Default: critical → HARD.

waiver.description: Suppresses one finding until it expires (model.Waiver).

finding.description: The drift finding id or a concept CURIE.
